integrity: Proof uses finite cyclic Fourier inversion and self-contained digit-sum computations. Finite exact verifier corroborates selected instances but does not establish infinite scope. Related unindexed literature is possible.
scientific_limitations: Complete canonical digit lengths only; moduli dividing base plus one; no extension to arbitrary cutoffs or general moduli. Classical even-length divisibility and the modulus-two case are not separately new.
title: Exact residue counts for palindromes modulo divisors of the base plus one
